meta.name: Anglesey
meta.description: Anglesey Circuit (Trac Mon), International (3.30 km), Coastal (2.47 km), National (1.91 km) and Club (1.28 km) layouts from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Welsh Government / NRW LIDAR composite DTM (1 m). Open, windswept coastal headland with the sea on three sides and Snowdonia to the east.

imported.source: Layout (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Heights: Welsh Government / Natural Resources Wales LIDAR composite DTM 1 m, contains Natural Resources Wales information (c) Natural Resources Wales and database right, Open Government Licence v3.0. Run-off, barriers and trees: measured from NRW LIDAR DSM/DTM (OGL v3.0) and OpenStreetMap (ODbL), barrier types from published track guides (tools/real_tracks_data/runoff_evidence.json).

pits.source: Pits: osm: OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0: Overpass over the recipe bbox, 2026-10-24 (tools/real_tracks_data/fetch_pits_osm.py); lidar: Welsh Government / NRW LIDAR composite DSM and DTM 1 m (DataMapWales COGs), OGL v3; maps: racingcircuits.info Anglesey International map
